evidence.acceptanceCriterion: R1/R3 item 1 - artifacts. Both committed artifact manifests hash to the value recorded in live-state.json, their sourceId and head match the entry, and for every artifact the blob committed at the target is byte-identical both to the manifest sourceSha256 and to the live file still present in the source checkout.
evidence.action: Read live-state.json at the target; hashed both committed manifests; for all 141 artifacts hashed the committed blob via git show and the live file via the recorded checkout path, comparing both against the manifest sourceSha256.
evidence.decisiveEvidence: 2 manifests: working-line a7edcf954667c1c0d15cd0ef59f5d491d1a6b8a2f634e723a5d7979a5ed60174 MATCH, ward-board fbdf963ca7e66a7461e463a7ba3d009c36e768eb65f22e97ab30e45b7fe19826 MATCH; sourceId and head MATCH for both. Artifact counts 2 (working-line, both status M) and 139 (ward-board, all untracked), 141 total. committed blob == manifest sourceSha256: 141/141. live file == manifest sourceSha256: 141/141. Artifacts absent: 0. Live files missing or unreadable: 0. FAILURES: 0.
evidence.falsifier: Any manifest hash mismatch, sourceId or head mismatch, artifact absent at the target, committed blob differing from sourceSha256, or live file drifted from the manifest.

evidence.acceptanceCriterion: R1/R3 item 2 - sources undisturbed. Both source checkouts remain on the recorded branch and HEAD with the recorded tracked status, and the ward-board checkout still holds exactly the same untracked path set as the manifest, not merely the same count.
evidence.action: Ran git --no-optional-locks -C <checkout> for rev-parse, status --untracked-files=no and ls-files --others --exclude-standard, so no index was written in either checkout; sorted the live untracked listing and compared it against the manifest sourcePaths with comm in both directions and diff.
evidence.decisiveEvidence: pr-2390-fix: branch claude/ward-flow-phases-6-7-design, HEAD 5db2f02fc6f0d04eed3425bc74b0adad438b7ea7, exactly 2 modified tracked files (ward-change-reasons.ts and tests/ward-change-reasons.test.ts, the same two the manifest records as M), 0 untracked. nostalgic-vaughan-7ee231: branch claude/ward-flow-print-fixes, HEAD 68e501e5fc725542e090a0698a87519ac242804b, 0 modified tracked, 139 untracked. Untracked path set versus manifest sourcePaths: comm empty in both directions, diff reports files identical. Exact set match. Read-only throughout; no write of any kind to either checkout.
evidence.falsifier: Either checkout drifted in branch, HEAD, tracked status, or untracked path set by any addition, removal or substitution.

evidence.acceptanceCriterion: R1/R3 item 3 - exports. For all six chats the committed export blob hashes to its recorded exportSha256 and the envelope's own chat and sessionId match its live-state entry.
evidence.action: For each of the six chatLogs entries, hashed the committed export blob and compared it to exportSha256, then compared the parsed envelope chat and sessionId against the entry.
evidence.decisiveEvidence: 6/6 export hashes MATCH; 6/6 envelope chat MATCH; 6/6 envelope sessionId MATCH. Sessions: Ward Decisions a4cba676, Ward Verifier 96a0e846, Ward Orchestrator 9e69b934, Ward Board db884133, Ward Referrals 2a7fcecc, Ward Core 23c91695. FAILURES: 0.
evidence.falsifier: Any export hash mismatch, or an envelope whose chat or sessionId disagrees with the entry it is recorded against.

evidence.acceptanceCriterion: R1/R3 item 4 - provenance binding. For all six chats the committed owner decision hashes to its recorded ownerDecisionSha256, and that decision's own chat, sessionId and decisionId match the entry it is attached to, with no crossed pairing between the six structurally near-identical records.
evidence.action: For each entry, hashed the committed decision blob against ownerDecisionSha256, then compared decision.chat to the entry chat, decision.sessionId to the EXPORT envelope's sessionId (so a swap between two entries could not pass by matching the entry alone), and decision.decisionId to the entry ownerDecisionId.
evidence.decisiveEvidence: 6/6 decision hashes MATCH; 6/6 chat MATCH; 6/6 sessionId MATCH against the export envelope; 6/6 decisionId MATCH. Pairings: a4cba676/-001, 96a0e846/-002, 9e69b934/-003, db884133/-004, 2a7fcecc/-005, 23c91695/-006, all six sessionIds distinct. No crossing. FAILURES: 0. LIMIT: this proves the binding is internally consistent and untampered; it does NOT prove the owner's original identification of which chat produced which session file, which the control README states is an owner judgement rather than a tool-derived fact.
evidence.falsifier: Any decision hash mismatch, or a decision bound to the wrong chat, session or decision id.

evidence.acceptanceCriterion: R1/R3 item 5 - archives. Each archived chat log is byte-identical to its source transcript under the Claude log root, and is a genuinely separate file rather than a link to it.
evidence.action: For all six, hashed the archive at the recorded archivedLogPath and compared to archivedLogSha256; hashed the source transcript at sourceLogPath; compared the two hashes; and used lstat to check symlink status and link count plus realpath on both paths.
evidence.decisiveEvidence: 6/6 archive hashes MATCH archivedLogSha256; 6/6 not symlinks; 6/6 nlink == 1 so not hard links; 6/6 byte-identical to their source transcript; 6/6 realpath(archive) != realpath(source), so each is a distinct file. FAILURES: 0.
evidence.falsifier: Any archive differing from its source, or resolving to the same file, or being a symlink or hard link.

risks.summary: NOTHING COMMITTED AFTER 89d7f99ec HAS BEEN INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. The Builder activation, the three transition receipts, the 895-source inventory and disposition manifest, the recovery bundle and restore, and all ward product commits from e6b7afb91 onward rest on Ward Lead's own checking. This role is structurally unable to verify them because its lease pins 89d7f99ec.

INDEPENDENCE PARTIALLY COMPROMISED for the activation work. This role advised Ward Lead on the sourceSha choice and on ordering the steady-state edit after the activation snapshot. Any later verdict on that activation is therefore partly marking this role's own reasoning and must be checked against the validator code rather than against that advice. A successor should treat the activation as unverified by an untainted party.

CUSTODY FAILURE OBSERVED AND ACKNOWLEDGED. Ward Lead believed it had issued the R1/R3 criterion and referred to it twice as open; it never arrived and no assignment was ever committed. Its SendMessage returned success, which it reasonably read as delivery. A successful send is not evidence of receipt, and a chat message is not a durable record. Ward Lead has agreed future criteria will be committed assignments.

Owner approval for the protected deletion is uncorroborated by this role. Nothing unique was at risk: both the abandoned and the live recovery bundle were confirmed present in the owner's backup store outside every checkout, and the abandoned receipts were pinned to sourceSha 6a8778b6f which five later non-evidence commits had already made unusable.
